note: Rewritten from the species description of Chhotani (1997), the original in English; alates were recorded as unknown and only the soldier is described, with workers also unrecorded; synonymy, bibliographic citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow; antennae, labrum and pronotum paler than the head capsule; mandibles reddish brown. Head pilosity relatively dense; abdomen densely pilose. Head capsule subrectangular in dorsal view, widest near the posterior margin (length to mandibular base 1.00 mm, maximum width 0.84 mm). Frontal projection short and rounded, situated at the middle of the anterior head margin, its anterior edge weakly convex, reaching the mandibular base. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 about as long as segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Anterior margin of the labrum broad and concave. Mandibles rod-like, slender, the apices weakly incurved, longer than the head capsule (left mandible 1.21 mm long; ratio of mandible length to head length 1.21). Postmentum club-shaped, the waist weakly constricted (length 0.43 mm, maximum width 0.14 mm, width at the waist 0.12 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.15 mm, width 0.33 mm).
